counting_policy: 339 non-Bevy tests plus 57 demo tests plus 44 Bevy render-library tests plus 21 Bevy integrations. The 25 headless-library cases overlap render-library cases and are counted once. Earlier attempts, targeted reruns, examples, actual CLI operations and native actions contribute no extra Rust cases.
measurement_provenance: Regional probe and process-operation evidence were collected before the final narrow turn-clearance predicate. Storage/operation code and fixture definitions did not change afterward. Full final Rust/Bevy/demo gates and native confirmation include the final movement correction.
scope: Bounded local correctness, real localhost TCP/TLS, SQLite recovery and Linux/X11 native interaction with Mesa software Vulkan. No complete Motor Town parity, AAA assets/physics, gaming-GPU performance, public account hosting, distributed authority or MMORPG concurrency claim.
